title: Questionnaire Accelerator: modular answer packs & tiered credits pilot
creator: Sasha Martinez
description:
Goal: Reduce sales/legal time spent answering large security questionnaires (SIG/CAIQ and vendor-specific forms) by providing modular, reusable answer packs and a tiered credit pricing pilot for self-serve attestation bundles.

Scope: Deliver a productized "Answer Pack" format that maps common SIG/CAIQ clauses to canonical answers, supports per-customer overrides, and surfaces provenance (evidence links + last-reviewed date). Build a checkout flow in the Console that lets customers purchase "attestation credits" (bundles of responses & evidence access) with tiered pricing depending on contract size and SLAs. Offer a pilot program for 6 enterprise accounts and measure time-to-close and support tickets avoided.

Key success metrics:
- Reduce average security questionnaire turnaround time for pilot accounts from baseline (7 business days) to <= 2 business days.
- Reduce manual effort for Solutions Engineering by at least 30% (measured via time logs and ticket counts).
- Demonstrate willingness-to-pay: at least 3 pilot customers convert to paid bundles by end of pilot.

Out of scope for pilot: full automation of vendor-specific questionnaires (we will support import + matching rules but not fully automated mapping in this phase). Not covering complex legal redlines—those will still route to Sales/Legal.

Stakeholders: Product (Sasha Martinez, Arjun Patel), Solutions Engineering (lead: Priya Rao), Legal (lead: Daniel Kim), Security/Compliance (lead: Mei Chen), Engineering (runtime + Console: ENG owners listed in dependencies).

Design & UX notes: Designs will show an "Answer Pack Library" in Console > Security > Attestations. Packs are taggable, searchable, and previewable with evidence links. Checkout flow will present recommended pack(s) for the customer's tier and estimated time savings. We will use an inline modal for uploading evidence and linking to Google Drive/Confluence records.

Compliance & trust: Every shipped Answer Pack must include an audit trail: author, last-review date, and linked evidence artifacts. Packs flagged as 'sensitive' require Security sign-off before being published.

Rollout plan: (1) Build the Answer Pack schema and editor (internal alpha). (2) Seed library with 20 canonical SIG/CAIQ packs created by Solutions Eng + Security. (3) Implement Console purchase flow and billing hooks (integrate with existing billing). (4) Run 6-customer pilot for 8 weeks, iterate on pricing and pack granularity, then decide on GA pricing packaging.
